title: The 6 Best Strollers for Small Cars
h1: The 6 Best Strollers for Small Cars
metaDescription: Our 6 picks for strollers for small cars, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at strollers for small cars using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Kolcraft Cloud Plus Lightweight Stroller
products.blurb: Key specs: 13 lb lightweight frame, Folds to roughly 12 by 34 inches, Multi-position reclining seat.
strengths: 13 lbs and a genuinely flat fold make it the easiest stroller in this list to lift into a small trunk one-handed
Folds flatter than most umbrella strollers, leaving more trunk space for other cargo
Reclining seat and large canopy are unusually full-featured for such a light, compact frame
limitations: No infant car seat compatibility, designed for toddlers who can sit supported
Smaller wheels mean a noticeably bumpier ride on rough sidewalks than full-size strollers
Storage basket is smaller than mid-size and full-size strollers

products.name: Summer Infant 3Dpac CS+ Compact Fold Stroller
products.blurb: Key specs: 16 lb lightweight frame, Compact tri-fold with auto lock and carry strap, Folds to roughly 20.5 by 21.5 by 14.5 inches.
strengths: Car seat compatibility without an adapter is rare at this compact a fold
Auto-lock tri-fold with carry strap makes it easy to sling over a shoulder while loading a trunk
16 lbs is light enough for one-handed lifting with a baby on the other arm
limitations: Folded footprint is larger than the Cloud Plus, though still small-car friendly
Ride comfort and suspension are basic compared to full-size strollers
Canopy coverage is smaller than premium strollers' extendable canopies
features: Compact tri-fold with auto lock and carry strap
Folds to roughly 20.5 by 21.5 by 14.5 inches
Car seat compatible with Graco Click Connect and Chicco KeyFit, no adapter

products.name: Graco Modes Pramette Stroller
products.blurb: Key specs: One-hand fold, True pram mode with flat-lying reversible seat, 3-in-1: car seat carrier, pramette, toddler stroller.
strengths: One-hand fold is fast even though the folded size is larger than dedicated compact strollers
True pram mode and 3-in-1 versatility that neither the Cloud Plus nor 3Dpac CS+ offer
Still fits most hatchback and mid-size sedan trunks despite the larger feature set
limitations: Larger folded footprint than the Cloud Plus or 3Dpac CS+, tighter in a very small trunk
Heavier frame than dedicated lightweight compact strollers
Not marketed as a compact stroller, so small-car buyers need to check the fold size against their trunk
features: True pram mode with flat-lying reversible seat
3-in-1: car seat carrier, pramette, toddler stroller
Removable child tray with cup holders

products.name: Summer Infant 3Dlite Convenience Stroller
limitations: Not for newborns without a car seat

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
